title: ElevenLabs Beauty & Personal Care Dialogue Skill Input v18
description: Generate safe, natural, ad-ready, plain-text ElevenLabs-style dialogue for beauty, cosmetic, personal care, hygiene, oral care, sunscreen, hair color, grooming, feminine care, and adjacent personal-use products. v18 optionally supports direct image uploads for product packaging/label analysis; images are supporting evidence, not a source for new claims.

product_details.description: Raw product listing/details supplied by the user. May contain Thai, English, mixed language, promotions, shipping text, or risky claims.

product_images.title: Product images (optional)
product_images.description: Optional image uploads for product photos, packaging, labels, ingredients, usage instructions, texture, swatches, or warnings. Upload by drag-and-drop or file picker; do not type URLs. Maximum 5 images. Images support product understanding and conflict/risk detection, but must not be used to invent claims.

items.description: Uploaded image file. Accepted through UI upload/drag-and-drop, not URL entry.

image_analysis_mode.title: Image analysis mode
image_analysis_mode.description: Controls how optional uploaded images are used. Default detects visible packaging/label details and conflicts/risks while keeping product_details as the primary source.

image_evidence_policy.title: Image evidence policy
image_evidence_policy.description: Keeps image use conservative: product text remains primary; only visible/readable image details may support the script; conflicts must be handled with safe neutral wording.

evergreen_mode.description: When true, ignore short-term promotions, temporary discounts, giveaways, shop logistics, shipping rules, and review/guarantee policy unless requested.

regulated_product_mode.description: Controls caution level for dental, intimate-care, hygiene, and medical-adjacent personal-use products.

no_meta_compliance_dialogue.description: When true, the final spoken dialogue must not mention banned claims, compliance rules, policy checks, or phrases like “ไม่ควรเคลม/ห้ามใช้คำ”. The rewrite must happen silently.

multi_sku_handling.description: Controls behavior when listings contain many unrelated SKUs/formulas. Default creates a neutral choose-the-right-formula script instead of merging all claims.

fragrance_brand_guard.description: For perfume/fragrance listings, remove famous brand names, dupe implications, and unauthorized comparisons from customer-facing dialogue.

near_eye_product_caution.description: For eye masks, brow pencils, eyelash curlers, and eye-area tools, include gentle-use/avoid-eye-contact caution when relevant.

self_heating_near_eye_caution.description: For steam/self-heating eye masks, include heat and eye-area cautions.

intimate_care_external_use_caution.description: For intimate cleansers, keep claims external-use, pH/free-from focused, and avoid treatment claims.

heat_appliance_safety_caution.description: For heated hair tools, include dry-hair, water, unplug, and temperature cautions.

dermatology_endorsement_guard.description: Omit unverified dermatologist/doctor recommendations as sales proof; use neutral label facts only.

simple_accessory_mode.description: For mirrors, hair patches, simple beauty accessories, focus on stable practical features and omit marketplace noise.

medical_device_cautious_mode.description: For scar gels, test kits, and medical-device-like listings, keep copy factual and add professional-use/label cautions.

supplement_warning_enabled.description: When a listing includes dietary supplements, include a balanced-diet/label-reading warning and avoid disease or treatment claims.

scalp_condition_guard.description: Softens hair-loss, dandruff, seborrheic, scalp acne, fungal, itch, redness, and inflammation claims.

textile_uv_guard.description: For UV apparel and textile protection claims, avoid absolute protection and remind about sunscreen/sun-safe habits for exposed skin.

clinical_number_simplifier.description: Do not use clinical percentages, x-times, or trial claims as spoken hooks; rewrite to practical non-guaranteed benefits.
